opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the evening for a lively atmosphere.

places.place_tip: Take a guided tour to learn about the history and architecture.

places.place_tip: Climb the tower for stunning views of Trinidad and the surrounding valley.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the waterfall at the end of the main trail.
